# Q-053: two transfer fees on one day, on the same two accounts, and the
# dollars the second draws on bought in a transaction written below it.
#
# The first fee draws on the dollars bought before the statement, which the
# book holds. The second states the guid of a split the file creates further
# down, so it is refused in the first pass and applied in the next, once that
# purchase is in the book. The two fees share a date and their accounts,
# which is all the check for a duplicate compares, and they are two fees.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_atomic_import_brings_a_book_back_to_a_state_it_exported.py.

	Assets:Wise USD -0.72 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "-0.97"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0e510000000000000000000000000d02"

		value: "-1.94"
